A stout wooden barrel fitted with brass hoops and a dispensing tap, filled with fresh tavern ale.

§6Function & Uses§r
• §7Pouring Ale:§r Right-click with an empty or partially drained §5Beer Mug§r to refill it.
• §7Barkeeper Workstation:§r Placing a keg near an unemployed villager will assign them the §6Barkeeper§r profession.
Crafted by reinforcing a §5Beer Barrel§r with four Iron Ingots.
